schema: CREATE TABLE "Sessions" ("user_id" INTEGER, "device_id" INTEGER, "started_at" DATE, "ended_at" DATE);
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT s1.user_id FROM Sessions AS s1 JOIN Sessions AS s2 ON s1.user_id = s2.user_id AND s1.device_id <> s2.device_id AND s2.started_at BETWEEN s1.started_at AND s1.ended_at

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant replaces asymmetric start-point containment (s2.started_at BETWEEN s1.started_at AND s1.ended_at) with symmetric endpoint bounds (a.started_at <= b.ended_at AND b.started_at <= a.ended_at), which imposes an extra constraint on the second row's ended_at column.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.user_id FROM Sessions AS a CROSS JOIN Sessions AS b WHERE a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.device_id <> b.device_id AND a.started_at <= b.ended_at AND b.started_at <= a.ended_at
